entities.name: Thaddeus H. Caraway
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thaddeus Horatius Caraway was an American politician who represented the state of Arkansas first in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1913 to 1921 and then in the U.S. Senate from 1921 until his death in 1931. He belonged to the Democratic Party.
